questions.q: Which of LTV's three customers is served by the Canada Operations BU and billed in CAD?
options: Harborview Industrial Supply
Tidewater Energy Systems
Great Lakes Automation Group
Meridian Bearing Supply Co.
questions.explain: Great Lakes Automation Group is located in Ontario and served by the Canadian subsidiary, billed in CAD.

questions.q: Which customer receives the most detailed setup in this lesson, including credit limit review and a configured remit-to/receipt method?
options: Tidewater Energy Systems
Harborview Industrial Supply
Great Lakes Automation Group
All three customers receive identical, minimal setup
questions.explain: Harborview Industrial Supply, LTV's largest distributor customer, gets full credit and receipt-method detail since later lessons follow it closely.

questions.q: What realistic detail does the lesson note about Harborview before this capstone's events begin?
options: It has no prior transaction history at all
It already has order history, including an older, smaller open invoice
It is a brand-new customer being onboarded for the first time
It only transacts in CAD
questions.explain: Harborview already has order history, including an older open invoice that becomes relevant again later in the capstone.

questions.q: What does a customer's 'profile class' set by default?
options: The company's chart of accounts structure
A set of default Receivables terms such as payment terms, credit review, and statement cycle
The supplier's preferred payment method
The fiscal calendar used by the business unit
questions.explain: A profile class applies default Receivables terms, like payment terms and credit review settings, to a customer account or site.

questions.q: Why must customer master data be configured before any invoicing occurs?
options: Oracle Fusion requires customers to be set up in the same period as the invoice
A Receivables transaction can't be created for a customer that doesn't exist, and cash can't be applied without a receipt method on file
Customers must first be approved by the Canadian legal entity
Invoicing is blocked until a customer reaches a $1 million credit limit
questions.explain: Invoicing and cash application both depend on customer master data existing first — there is no transaction without the underlying record.
